competences.description: Attacks the enemy, dealing damage and transferring 2 harmful effects on you to the enemy. Increases the damage by 15% if there are no harmful effects to transfer.

effets.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies with mighty waves, Silencing them for 2 turns. The enemies under the Silence Effect won't be able to use skills with cooldown time excluding the passive skills.

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on all allies and grants them Immunity and Invincibility for 2 turns. If the ally's harmful effects are removed, the duration of Immunity effect will be increased by 1 turn of that ally.

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
effets.note: +1 for ally if cleansed any debuff on given ally

effets.description: The target will be invincible and receive no damage.
